label: Division 296 tax rate on taxable superannuation earnings
quote: Division 296 tax applies at a rate of an additional 15% to your taxable super earnings.
pattern: applies at a rate of an additional ([\d.]+%) to your taxable super earnings
notes: The page says Division 296 tax applies from 1 July 2026 and states no end. The 15% rate is set by s 5 of the Superannuation (Building a Stronger and Fairer Super System) Imposition Act 2026 (No. 9, 2026), and ITAA 1997 s 296-15 applies to the 2026-27 income year and later years (Income Tax (Transitional Provisions) Act 1997 s 296-1(1), inserted by the Treasury Laws Amendment (Building a Stronger and Fairer Super System) Act 2026, No. 8, 2026): https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2026A00009/asmade
